description: Shared horizontal event art, independent of availability/recency. Home payload optional eventArtwork points to up to eight immutable shards under the configured Home base URL. Shard filenames must be distinct; target keys must be distinct across shards and total at most 2000 (cross-document invariants enforced by provider and consumer). Keep last verified art on refresh failure; join only matching expanded catalog SHA. Signed source URLs never leave collector. Shards and PNGs are published before Home manifest. Shared-art releases allow at most 70 objects under the existing 16 MiB write ceiling; legacy Home releases remain at 42.

cursor.description: Last attempted target, used only by producer for bounded fair rotation, including failures. Never event recency.

additionalProperties.description: [PNG SHA-256, last successful checkedAt Unix seconds]. PNG must be the observed first-party listbutton_image in eve_listbutton and horizontal (ratio 3..6). URLs derive as images/<sha>.png. CheckedAt is NOT event release time.
